products.name: Magick Box
products.blurb: AI creative platform on iOS, Android and the web
highlights: Built and run the Python 3.12 / FastAPI backend behind every client: around 250 endpoints across 21 feature packages on a 58-collection MongoDB model, with a ranked feed, Redis caching and rate limiting.
Exposed every generation type through magick_ai with credit-based tiers, so a new model ships as configuration rather than code.
Moved long-running generation onto Celery with retries, backoff and time limits, so a provider outage fails one job instead of the API.
Built Mini Cinema, a multi-shot AI film pipeline that streams reasoning, approval gates and renders to the client as typed content blocks.
Built real-time and group chat over Socket.IO with token streaming, AI personas alongside human members, and pub/sub keeping pods in sync.
Built billing on Stripe, RevenueCat and AdMob with signature-verified webhooks and an idempotent credit ledger, so retried webhooks never grant credits twice.
Implemented device-bound JWT sessions, Argon2 hashing with transparent migration of legacy hashes, email OTP and Google and Apple sign-in, so existing users kept their accounts through the migration.
Deployed to Kubernetes on AWS with Helm, Istio mTLS and autoscaling from one Docker image; GitHub Actions runs 181 tests, build, release and DAST scans on every change.

products.name: magick_ai
products.blurb: Multi-service AI SDK the Magick Box backend depends on (private repository, access on request)
highlights: Wrote and maintain the Python SDK behind Magick Box: one UniversalAgent call covers chat, image, video, music and podcast generation across OpenAI, Google, Stability, Replicate, Suno and AIML via LiteLLM. Around 280 modules, 35+ tagged releases.
Built the agents on top: chat orchestration with per-type handlers and validators, a persona agent, podcast and storybook generators, and automatic tagging.
Added document analysis (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint), web search and prompt enhancement, with standardised results and one error model in place of six provider-specific ones.

products.name: Magick Whisper
products.blurb: Dog-training companion for the Guardian collar, on TestFlight
highlights: Took the product from an empty repository to TestFlight in seven weeks: a Go API (Gin, pgx, PostgreSQL) and a Flutter app with Riverpod and go_router.
Implemented Google and Apple sign-in against cached JWKS with 15-minute access tokens and rotating refresh tokens, kept optional to pass App Store guideline 5.1.1.
Added on-device speech recognition with Whisper and Silero VAD, plus an offline session store with retry-safe uploads, so sessions record without a connection.
Go tests run against a real PostgreSQL in CI and the build fails if any database test skips; Codemagic ships signed builds to TestFlight and Google Play.

products.name: Legal document RAG
products.blurb: Two retrieval prototypes over Thai statutes, Aug – Oct 2024 (private repositories)
highlights: Built policyGraphRAG, a question-answering API over eleven Thai statutes: Microsoft GraphRAG per act with GPT-4o entity extraction, community summaries and LanceDB embeddings, served from FastAPI. Started the repo and built the indexing; a team of four added contract analysis.
Built vision-rag, a multimodal RAG chatbot that indexes PDF pages as images with ColPali and answers with GPT-4o vision, so scanned statutes work without OCR.

products.name: Internal compliance tooling
products.blurb: Self-service compliance data tooling for the bank's legal team
highlights: Replaced the compliance team’s manual data requests, which arrived as Excel exports from the core banking team, with a self-service Angular and Spring Boot web app.
Designed the relational schema and SQL behind the reporting datasets, with indexed queries and paginated exports so large customer tables load without timing out.
Built the Java REST APIs and an audit trail of who viewed which record, replacing untracked spreadsheet copies.
